title: Unitary Weil Representation on Orthogonal Direct Sums
body_html:
Unitary Weil Representation on Orthogonal Direct Sums

Let $$ F=\bigoplus_r F^r $$ be an orthogonal direct sum of $K/k$-unitary spaces, with restricted forms $i_r$. Then, after restricting from $U(F,i)$ to $\prod_r U(F^r,i_r)$, the unitary Weil representation factors as $$ W^{F,i}\big|_{\prod_r U(F^r,i_r)} = \bigotimes_r W^{F^r,i_r}. $$
